definitions.explanation: Indicates that something stands out far above the rest. Emphasizes a superlative quality.

examples.japanese: とびきりおいしい⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧だ。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とびきり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Today, they showed me their best smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とびきり⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦ディナー→ディナー：27996_dinaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to prepare an extra-special dinner for the birthday.

notes:
とびきり can be used both as an adverb (modifying adjectives) and as a no-adjective (modifying nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- とびきり + adjective: exceptionally ~
- とびきり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: top-notch ~, the very best ~
- とびきりおいしい: exceptionally delicious
- とびきり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: the best smile

ETYMOLOGY: From {飛|と}び{切|き}り, literally "flying cut" — something so outstanding it jumps out from the rest.

USAGE: Carries a warm, enthusiastic tone. Common in everyday conversation, especially when praising food, experiences, or personal qualities.
